Data acquisition device for artificial intelligence machine learning

section.content: The invention discloses a data acquisition device for artificial intelligence machine learning, which belongs to the technical field of data acquisition, and comprises a frame body, wherein a connecting plate is arranged on the lower end surface of the frame body, a driving mechanism is arranged between the connecting plate and the frame body, an acquisition device is arranged at the middle position in the frame body, and a limiting mechanism is arranged between the acquisition device and the frame body; the limiting mechanism comprises a limiting rod, a handle, a baffle, a spring and a slot, the inside both sides position at collection system is seted up to the slot, limiting rod slides and pegs graft in the inside both sides position of framework, baffle fixed connection is at the surface of limiting rod, the spring cup joints the outside of limiting rod and is close to the position of baffle, limiting rod corresponds with the position of slot, collection system has better guard action, and can conveniently install its position and prescribe a limit to, also can assist its data information to the environment on every side to gather, the convenience of use of device has been improved greatly, and is relatively practical.

本发明公开了数据采集技术领域的一种人工智能机器学习的数据采集装置，包括框体，框体的下端面设置有连接板，连接板与框体之间设置有驱动机构，框体的内部中间位置设置有采集装置，采集装置与框体之间设置有限定机构；限定机构包括有限定杆、手柄、挡板、弹簧与插槽，插槽开设在采集装置的内部两侧位置，限定杆滑动插接在框体的内部两侧位置，挡板固定连接在限定杆的外表面，弹簧套接在限定杆的外部靠近挡板的位置，限定杆与插槽的位置对应，对采集装置具有较好的防护作用，且能够方便将其位置进行安装限定，也能够辅助其对周围的环境的数据信息进行采集，大大提高了装置的使用便捷性，较为实用。

Artificial intelligence machine learning's data acquisition deviceTechnical Field

The invention relates to the technical field of data acquisition, in particular to a data acquisition device for artificial intelligence machine learning.

Background

The artificial intelligence machine gathers data through the staff more, then with data transmission to the interior analysis of logical operation mechanism in the artificial intelligence machine, with this effect that reaches the study, current data acquisition equipment, its inside image acquisition memory cell and sound acquisition unit that is provided with, shoot the thing that needs the collection through the camera on its upper portion, then with picture dump to image acquisition memory cell, and through the recording port of its lower part, can dump the sound that the outside spreads to the sound acquisition unit in, in fact, need carry data acquisition device to the open air more, carry out sound and image acquisition in the open air.

The data acquisition device for the artificial intelligence machine learning is difficult to protect in the using process, is inconvenient to connect and position the acquisition device and the using position, is difficult to fully acquire information of the surrounding environment, and has disadvantages in use.

Disclosure of Invention

The invention aims to provide a data acquisition device for artificial intelligence machine learning, which aims to solve the problems that the data acquisition device is difficult to protect in the using process, the acquisition device is inconvenient to connect and position with the using position, and the information acquisition of the surrounding environment is difficult to fully acquire in the background technology.

In order to achieve the purpose, the invention provides the following technical scheme: a data acquisition device for artificial intelligence machine learning comprises a frame body, wherein a connecting plate is arranged on the lower end face of the frame body, a driving mechanism is arranged between the connecting plate and the frame body, an acquisition device is arranged at the middle position in the frame body, and a limiting mechanism is arranged between the acquisition device and the frame body;

the limiting mechanism comprises a limiting rod, a handle, a baffle, a spring and a slot, the slot is arranged at the two sides of the interior of the collecting device, the limiting rod is inserted in the two sides of the interior of the frame body in a sliding mode, the baffle is fixedly connected to the outer surface of the limiting rod, the spring is sleeved at the position, close to the baffle, of the exterior of the limiting rod, and the limiting rod corresponds to the slot.

Preferably, the driving mechanism includes a motor, a gear, a ring gear and a bearing, and the motor is disposed at a position on the upper end surface of the connecting plate, the position being close to the frame.

Preferably, the toothed ring is fixedly connected to the outer surface of the frame body, the frame body is connected with the connecting plate through a bearing, the gear is fixedly connected with an output shaft of the motor, and the gear is in meshed connection with the toothed ring.

Preferably, the inner wall of the frame body is fixedly connected with supporting blocks at two sides, the upper end face of each supporting block is fixedly connected with a contact pad, and the contact pads are in contact connection with the lower end face of the acquisition device.

Preferably, a cover is disposed on the upper end surface of the frame, a hinge is disposed between one end of the cover and the frame, and the other end of the cover is fastened to the frame.

Preferably, a pressing mechanism is arranged between the cover body and the collecting device, the pressing mechanism comprises a threaded column, a handle and a pressing plate, and the handle is fixedly connected to the upper end face of the threaded column.

Preferably, according to the upper end face intermediate position fixedly connected with fixed column of pressing the board, the fixed column is pegged graft in the inside of screw thread post, and rotates between fixed column and the screw thread post to be connected.

Preferably, collection system's lower terminal surface intermediate position is provided with supporting mechanism, and supporting mechanism is including connecting cylinder, roof, the body of rod and damping spring, and the quantity of connecting cylinder is a plurality of, and the size and dimension is different, cup joints between a plurality of connecting cylinder, and the bottom passes through damping spring to be connected between it, and the innermost of connecting cylinder is provided with the body of rod, the up end fixedly connected with roof of the body of rod, roof and collection system contact.

Compared with the prior art, the invention has the beneficial effects that: the slot of collection system both sides can remove the position of limited rod slowly, later can promote the baffle under the effect of spring, and then limited rod can peg graft in the inside of slot, prescribe a limit to collection system's position, this process roof contacts with collection system's lower terminal surface all the time, can stretch out and draw back and part through damping spring between each connecting cylinder, when needs demolish collection system and framework, can stimulate the limited rod to the outside through the handle, and then just can drive the baffle and remove, compress the spring, afterwards limited rod just can break away from with the slot, and then just can break away from between collection system and the framework, in the time of using, for better collection to the environment on every side, therefore need driving motor to drive gear and rotate, and then the gear can drive the ring gear and rotate, the ring gear can drive the framework and rotate, therefore just can drive collection system rotatory, therefore just can drive collection system rotation, have better collection effect to the environment on every side, have better protective effect to collection system, and can conveniently install its position and prescribe a limit to its data information of environment on every side, greatly improve the convenience of gathering, the convenience.

Of course, it is not necessary for any product in which the invention is practiced to achieve all of the above-described advantages at the same time.

Drawings

In order to more clearly illustrate the technical solutions of the embodiments of the present invention, the drawings used in the description of the embodiments will be briefly introduced below, and it is obvious that the drawings in the following description are only some embodiments of the present invention, and it is obvious for those skilled in the art that other drawings can be obtained according to the drawings without creative efforts.

FIG. 1 is a schematic view of the overall structure of the present invention;

FIG. 2 is a combined view of a restraint bar and an acquisition device of the present invention;

FIG. 3 is a view of the combination of the collection assembly of the present invention with a support block;

FIG. 4 is a view of the rod body and the damping spring in combination according to the present invention;

fig. 5 is a combination view of the motor and the gear of the present invention.

In the drawings, the components represented by the respective reference numerals are listed below:

1. a frame body; 2. a cover body; 3. a threaded post; 4. a pressing plate; 5. a hinge; 6. a restraining bar; 7. a collection device; 8. a support block; 9. a contact pad; 10. a motor; 11. a gear; 12. a bearing; 13. a toothed ring; 14. a top plate; 15. a connecting cylinder; 16. a connecting plate; 17. a handle; 18. a spring; 19. a baffle plate; 20. a rod body; 21. a damping spring.

Detailed Description

The technical solutions in the embodiments of the present invention will be clearly and completely described below with reference to the drawings in the embodiments of the present invention, and it is obvious that the described embodiments are only a part of the embodiments of the present invention, and not all of the embodiments. All other embodiments, which can be derived by a person skilled in the art from the embodiments given herein without making any creative effort, shall fall within the protection scope of the present invention.

Referring to fig. 1 to 5, the present invention provides a technical solution of a data acquisition device for artificial intelligence machine learning: the device comprises a frame body 1, wherein a connecting plate 16 is arranged on the lower end face of the frame body 1, a driving mechanism is arranged between the connecting plate 16 and the frame body 1, an acquisition device 7 is arranged at the middle position in the frame body 1, and a limiting mechanism is arranged between the acquisition device 7 and the frame body 1;

the limiting mechanism comprises a limiting rod 6, a handle 17, a baffle plate 19, a spring 18 and slots, the slots are formed in the positions of the two sides of the inner portion of the collecting device 7, the limiting rod 6 is inserted into the positions of the two sides of the inner portion of the frame body 1 in a sliding mode, the baffle plate 19 is fixedly connected to the outer surface of the limiting rod 6, the spring 18 is sleeved on the position, close to the baffle plate 19, of the outer portion of the limiting rod 6, and the limiting rod 6 corresponds to the slots in position.

The position of the collecting device 7 is limited, in the process, the top plate 14 is always in contact with the lower end face of the collecting device 7, all the connecting cylinders 15 can be separated in a telescopic mode through the damping springs 21, when the collecting device 7 and the frame body 1 need to be detached, the limiting rod 6 can be pulled outwards through the handle 17, the baffle 19 can be driven to move, the springs 18 are compressed, then the limiting rod 6 can be separated from the inserting groove, the collecting device 7 and the frame body 1 can be separated, in use, for better collecting the surrounding environment, the driving mechanism comprises a motor 10, a gear 11, a toothed ring 13 and a bearing 12, the motor 10 is arranged at the position, close to the frame body 1, of the upper end face of the connecting plate 16, the toothed ring 13 is fixedly connected to the outer surface of the frame body 1, the frame body 1 is connected with the connecting plate 16 through the bearing 12, the gear 11 is fixedly connected with the output shaft of the motor 10, and the gear 11 is in meshed connection with the toothed ring 13.

Inner wall both sides position fixedly connected with supporting shoe 8 of framework 1, the up end fixedly connected with contact pad 9 of supporting shoe 8, contact pad 9 is connected with collection system 7's lower terminal surface contact, the up end of framework 1 is provided with lid 2, be provided with hinge 5 between the one end of lid 2 and the framework 1, lock joint between the other end of lid 2 and the framework 1, lid 2 and collection system 7 between be provided with pressing means, pressing means is including screw thread post 3, handle and pressing plate 4, handle fixed connection is at the up end of screw thread post 3, the up end intermediate position fixedly connected with fixed column of pressing plate 4, the fixed column is pegged graft in screw thread post 3's inside, and rotate between fixed column and the screw thread post 3 and be connected.

The lower terminal surface intermediate position of collection system 7 is provided with supporting mechanism, and supporting mechanism is including connecting cylinder 15, roof 14, the body of rod 20 and damping spring 21, and the quantity of connecting cylinder 15 is a plurality of, and the size and dimension is different, cup joints between a plurality of connecting cylinder 15, and the bottom passes through damping spring 21 to be connected between it, and the innermost of connecting cylinder 15 is provided with the body of rod 20, the up end fixedly connected with roof 14 of the body of rod 20, roof 14 and collection system 7 contact.

One specific application of this embodiment is: when the intelligent acquisition device 7 is used, the frame body 1 is placed at a use position and is contacted with the ground through the connecting plate 16, then the cover body 2 is opened, the acquisition device 7 is lifted from the inside of the frame body 1, then the slots at two sides of the acquisition device 7 can be slowly moved to the position of the limiting rod 6, then the baffle 19 can be pushed under the action of the spring 18, further the limiting rod 6 can be inserted into the slots, the position of the acquisition device 7 is limited, in the process, the top plate 14 is always contacted with the lower end face of the acquisition device 7, each connecting cylinder 15 can be separated in a telescopic mode through the damping spring 21, when the acquisition device 7 is required to be detached from the frame body 1, the limiting rod 6 can be pulled outwards through the handle 17, and then the baffle 19 can be driven to move, compress spring 18, later qualifies pole 6 just can break away from with the slot, and then just can break away from between collection system 7 and the framework 1, when using, for better collection to the environment on every side, consequently, need driving motor 10 to drive gear 11 and rotate, and then gear 11 can drive ring gear 13 and rotate, ring gear 13 can drive framework 1 and rotate, consequently just can drive collection system 7 rotatory, have better diversified collection effect to the environment on every side, collection system 7 has better guard action, and can conveniently install its position and prescribe a limit, also can assist its data information to the environment on every side to gather, the convenience of use of device has been improved greatly, and is practical.

The product model provided by the invention is only used according to the structural characteristics of the product, the product can be adjusted and modified after being purchased to be more matched and consistent with the technical scheme of the invention, the product model is an optimal application technical scheme, the product model can be replaced and modified according to the required technical parameters, and the product model is well known by the technical personnel in the field, so that the technical scheme provided by the invention can clearly obtain the corresponding use effect.

In the description herein, references to the description of "one embodiment," "an example," "a specific example," etc., mean that a particular feature, structure, material, or characteristic described in connection with the embodiment or example is included in at least one embodiment or example of the invention. In this specification, the schematic representations of the terms used above do not necessarily refer to the same embodiment or example. Furthermore, the particular features, structures, materials, or characteristics described may be combined in any suitable manner in any one or more embodiments or examples.

The preferred embodiments of the invention disclosed above are intended to be illustrative only. The preferred embodiments are not intended to be exhaustive or to limit the invention to the precise embodiments disclosed. Obviously, many modifications and variations are possible in light of the above teaching. The embodiments were chosen and described in order to best explain the principles of the invention and the practical application, to thereby enable others skilled in the art to best utilize the invention. The invention is limited only by the claims and their full scope and equivalents.
